subject.title: Containerized/self-hosted deploys can't use externalized channel plugins: openKeyedStore is gated to trusted plugins, with no supported way to trust a self-hosted channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a provenance-preserving immutable official plugin package/install-record root or equivalent self-hosted container deployment contract while continuing to deny raw load-path/config trust?
rationale: The choice decides which external channel plugins receive trusted host-managed state and ingress capabilities and likely changes install, config, state, and container provisioning contracts.

options.title: Approve Immutable Official Provenance Root
options.body: Define a supported build-time official install/provenance path outside mutable runtime state and require tests plus container proof that raw load-path packages remain denied.

options.title: Document Build-Time State Coupling
options.body: Document that self-hosted images must ship and mount the same OpenClaw state containing the package and install record, then close this as not planned.

options.title: Defer To Broader Keyed-State Model
options.body: Hold this issue behind the broader community/plugin keyed-state capability decision, accepting that official self-hosted channel deployments remain blocked meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Approve Immutable Official Provenance Root
recommendation.body: Define a supported build-time official install/provenance path outside mutable runtime state and require tests plus container proof that raw load-path packages remain denied.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the live issue and already stated the current trust-model intent in the thread.
